veld-af-dribbel-afronden.naam: Dribble through the gate and finish
veld-af-dribbel-afronden.uitleg: Dribble at goal from 30 m, choose the left or right gate in good time, accelerate through it and finish into the far corner inside the box. Then jog back round the outside to the queue (the ball stays in the net).
veld-af-dribbel-afronden.organisatie: Queue with balls 30 m out, central in front of goal. Two cone gates (2.5 m wide) at 19 m, left and right. Keeper in goal.
coachpunten: Ball close to your feet at the gate, then a bigger touch towards goal
Take a quick look before you shoot: where is the keeper?
Place it into the far corner, low, with the inside of the foot or your laces

makkelijker: Bigger goal or no keeper (keeper plays with hands behind their back)
moeilijker: The coach only calls which gate at 22 m
A defender starts at the gate and may put you under pressure

veld-af-pass-in-de-loop.naam: Pass into the run and finish first time
veld-af-pass-in-de-loop.uitleg: The attacker starts from the right and makes a diagonal run towards goal. The coach plays a ball from their pile into the run; the attacker finishes first time. Then back to the queue and the next one goes.
veld-af-pass-in-de-loop.organisatie: Coach with a pile of balls centrally at 21 m. Queue of attackers on the right at about 26 m (by the corner of the box). Keeper in goal.
coachpunten: Timing: accelerate as the coach touches the ball
Body over the ball keeps your shot low
First time: inside of the foot for placement, laces for power

moeilijker: Start on the left: finish with the other foot
A defender runs with you from the queue
The coach sometimes plays it in the air: volley or header

veld-af-voorzetten.naam: Low and high crosses: attack the box and finish
veld-af-voorzetten.uitleg: The winger dribbles to the byline and crosses. Two strikers attack the box: one to the near post, one to the far post. First a low, hard cross that is tapped in at the near post; then a high cross to the far post for a header.
veld-af-voorzetten.organisatie: Winger on the right at about 16 m with a pile of balls. Two strikers centrally at 20–24 m. Keeper in goal. Back to the starting spots after each cross; swap roles regularly.
coachpunten: Strikers: don't go too early, start your run when the winger looks up
Near post: get across the defender or keeper, first time with the inside of the foot
Header: take off from one foot, use your forehead, eyes open, head it down

makkelijker: The winger may control the ball first
Throw the cross in by hand (high ball)
moeilijker: A third runner to the edge of the box (cutback)
Cross first time after a pass from behind

veld-af-onder-druk.uitleg: The coach plays the ball in behind. The attacker sprints onto it; the defender starts diagonally behind and tries to catch up. The attacker takes the ball forward and has to finish before the defender gets there.
veld-af-onder-druk.organisatie: Coach with balls at 30 m. Attacker 3 m diagonally in front, defender 3.5 m diagonally behind (on the other side). Keeper in goal. Attacker and defender swap after each go.
coachpunten: Push your first touch far enough forward to keep your speed
Body between defender and ball (shield it)
Don't wait too long: finish as soon as you are in the box

makkelijker: The defender may only follow, no tackling
moeilijker: Two attackers against one defender: who gets the ball?
The ball comes in the air: control it out of the air first

veld-af-afstandsschot.uitleg: Pass to the coach (or a teammate) on the edge of the box. They lay the ball back first time into your path, and you strike it first time, hard and low, from about 20 m. Alternate power and placement.
veld-af-afstandsschot.organisatie: Queue with balls centrally at 29 m. Coach (lay-off player) at 19 m with their back to goal. Keeper in goal.
coachpunten: Standing foot next to the ball, knee and body over it
Strike through the ball with your laces, ankle locked
Follow your shot in: there may be a rebound

moeilijker: The lay-off sometimes goes wide: shoot with your weaker foot
A defender starts by the lay-off player and may block

veld-af-duel-twee-rijen.naam: Race for the ball: 1v1 to goal
veld-af-duel-twee-rijen.uitleg: The coach plays a ball between two queues. The front player of each queue sprints for it: whoever wins the ball attacks the goal, the other defends. A goal is a point for your team. Which team is ahead after 10 duels?
veld-af-duel-twee-rijen.organisatie: Two queues (red team and blue team) at 30 m, 14 m apart. Coach with a pile of balls in the middle between the queues. Keeper in goal.
coachpunten: Attacker: body between opponent and ball, then get to goal quickly
Defender: don't dive in, stay between the attacker and the goal
Switch quickly: if you lose the ball, defend straight away

makkelijker: Ball closer to the attacking queue
moeilijker: 2v2 (two players from each queue at once)
If the defender wins the ball, they can score in a mini goal behind the queues
The ball comes in the air: control it first

veld-cv-ladder-slalom-schot.naam: Ladder, first touch, slalom and shot
veld-cv-ladder-slalom-schot.uitleg: The player runs through the ladder with quick feet, controls a pass from the coach, dribbles a slalom round three cones and shoots at goal. Then they rejoin the back of the queue.
veld-cv-ladder-slalom-schot.organisatie: 4 m ladder 30 m from goal, three cones 3 m apart behind it. Coach beside the ladder with balls. Keeper in goal. The next player starts as the previous one enters the slalom.
coachpunten: Ladder: on the balls of your feet, active arms, don't look at your feet
First touch in one movement towards the slalom
Slalom: small touches, ball close to your foot; then look up and shoot

makkelijker: No ladder, start with the ball at your feet
moeilijker: First touch with your weaker foot
After the slalom, a one-two with the coach before shooting
A defender presses from the last cone

veld-cv-kaats-doordiepen.naam: One-two round the mannequin, run in behind and finish
veld-cv-kaats-doordiepen.uitleg: The player dribbles at the mannequin (defender), plays a one-two with a teammate and sprints past the mannequin in behind. The return pass arrives in their path and they finish first time.
veld-cv-kaats-doordiepen.organisatie: Mannequin 18 m from goal, lay-off player 4 m beside it. The player starts with a ball at 26 m. After each go the shooter becomes the lay-off player and the lay-off player joins the queue.
coachpunten: Commit the defender with your dribble before you play the one-two
Accelerate past the other side of the mannequin straight after your pass
Lay-off player: first time, into the runner's path

makkelijker: The return pass may take two touches
The shooter may control the ball first
moeilijker: A real defender instead of the mannequin
Straight after the shot, a second ball from the coach: rebound

veld-cv-draaien-voorzet.uitleg: The wide player receives the ball with their back to goal, controls it and turns away in one movement. They dribble down the touchline and deliver a high cross. The striker attacks the near post and heads it in.
veld-cv-draaien-voorzet.organisatie: Passer centrally at 30 m, wide player on the flank at 22 m, striker around the penalty spot. Rotate after each attack: passer → wide player → striker → passer.
coachpunten: First touch with the outside (or inside) of the foot away from the opponent, straight into the turn
Look up before you cross: where is the striker running?
Striker: don't go too early, curve your run to the near post

makkelijker: The striker starts in the box
moeilijker: A defender behind the wide player
A second striker attacks the far post
Cross first time after the dribble

veld-cv-overlap-voorzet.naam: Overlap on the wing, low cross and finish
veld-cv-overlap-voorzet.uitleg: The midfielder passes to the wide player and runs round the outside (overlap). The wide player plays the ball into their path. They go almost to the byline and put in a low cross to the near post, where the striker finishes first time.
veld-cv-overlap-voorzet.organisatie: Midfielder at 24 m, wide player on the flank at 18 m, striker around the penalty spot. Rotate after each attack. Also from the other side.
coachpunten: Straight after the pass, go round the outside at speed
Wide player: a short dribble inside draws the defender, then play it into the run
Low cross: hard along the ground between keeper and defenders

makkelijker: The wide player stands still and sets the ball up
moeilijker: A defender on the wide player
A second striker at the far post
Cross first time on the run

veld-af-kaatsen-verdediger-rug.uitleg: The striker has a defender right behind them. They receive the ball from the passer and lay it straight back, spin away from the defender, receive the ball in behind and finish against the keeper.
veld-af-kaatsen-verdediger-rug.organisatie: Striker 19 m from goal with the defender right behind, passer with balls at 30 m. Full-size goal with keeper. Roles swap after each go.
coachpunten: Striker: make contact with the defender first, then ask for the ball
Lay it off first time, along the ground, back to feet
Spin away to the side where the defender isn't, and accelerate

makkelijker: The defender plays at half pace
The striker may control the ball first
moeilijker: Finish within 3 seconds of the through ball

veld-af-dribbelrace-1t1.uitleg: Two players start a dribbling course at the same time, each with a ball: a slalom through the poles. The right-hand course is deliberately a bit longer. Whoever finishes first shoots at goal straight away, then turns to defend 1v1 against the other player, who finishes just after. Afterwards the players swap courses.
veld-af-dribbelrace-1t1.organisatie: Two pole slaloms about 20 m from goal: three poles on the left, four on the right (a bit further out). Players in two queues, each with a ball. Keeper in goal.
coachpunten: Dribble with small touches, ball close to your foot
Switch straight after your shot: get between the attacker and the goal
Attacker: up the tempo and shoot as soon as there is space

makkelijker: The defender may only go on the coach's signal
moeilijker: Longer slalom with cuts and turns
Two against one: the first two to finish play together
Shoot within 3 seconds of the course

veld-af-schieten-onder-druk.uitleg: The attacker stands on the edge of the box with a defender 3 m behind them. The server plays the ball in from the side; at that moment the defender sprints in to block the shot. The attacker has to finish quickly: set it up with the first touch and shoot. Take one touch too many and the defender catches up and wins the ball.
veld-af-schieten-onder-druk.organisatie: Attacker at 19 m straight in front of goal, defender 3 m behind them. Server with balls on the right, 18 m from goal and 12 m to the side. Keeper in goal. Attacker and defender swap after two balls.
coachpunten: Know which corner you’re going for before the ball arrives
First touch diagonally forwards, so the ball is set up to shoot straight away
Quick and low: a quick shot beats a pretty one

makkelijker: The attacker may take two touches before shooting
moeilijker: The defender starts alongside the attacker
The pass comes in at mid-height: control it out of the air

veld-af-cutback.uitleg: The wide player dribbles down the flank to just short of the byline. Two players attack the box: the first to the near post (dragging the keeper and defenders with them), the second holds back slightly and arrives around the penalty spot. The wide player cuts the ball back to the runner at the spot, who finishes first time.
veld-af-cutback.organisatie: On half a pitch. Wide player with balls on the right, 26 m from goal, two attackers centrally at 20–26 m. Keeper in goal. Rotate after each go, also from the left.
coachpunten: Wide player: go almost to the byline, then look up and cut it back along the ground
Runner at the spot: don’t arrive too early, get there as the ball is travelling
Near post: attack it hard, that creates space behind you

makkelijker: The wide player cuts it back gently
The runner may control it first
moeilijker: The wide player chooses: cutback or cross to the near post

veld-af-snel-na-balwinst.naam: Quick finish after winning the ball
veld-af-snel-na-balwinst.uitleg: Two defenders pass the ball around in the middle zone. Two attackers press and try to win it. If they do, they have to score on the big goal within 8 seconds; the defenders sprint back to stop them. Done in time = a point.
veld-af-snel-na-balwinst.organisatie: On half a pitch. 30 × 14 m middle zone, 23–37 m from goal. Two defenders (bibs) with the ball in the zone, two attackers with them. Keeper in goal. The coach counts to 8 out loud.
coachpunten: Press together: one on the ball, the other on the passing lane
After winning it: first touch forwards, don’t look back first
Get to goal quickly and take your teammate with you: 2 against the keeper before the defenders get back

makkelijker: The defenders may not sprint back
moeilijker: After a goal, go again straight away: the defenders get a new ball

veld-af-golven-na-inworp.naam: Attacking in waves after a throw-in
veld-af-golven-na-inworp.uitleg: Throw-in on the flank, level with the box. The receiver comes short, controls the ball and dribbles towards the byline. Meanwhile the attackers arrive in the box in waves: first two players to the near and far post, then a third player who stays behind them and arrives around the edge of the box. The receiver picks the free player; in the example they cut it back to the third runner, who finishes.
veld-af-golven-na-inworp.organisatie: On half a pitch. Thrower on the right touchline, 22 m from the byline, receiver 6 m infield. Two attackers at 24–28 m (first wave), a third at 32 m (second wave). Keeper in goal. Rotate after each attack.
coachpunten: Thrower: two hands, ball behind your head and both feet on the ground; throw to the receiver’s feet or chest
First wave: split the posts, don’t both go to the same place
Second wave: stay behind the ball and arrive late; the cutback is often the best chance

makkelijker: The receiver may cross from standing
moeilijker: The receiver must release the ball within 4 seconds
The thrower joins in and becomes the second wave

veld-af-kopballen-voorzet.uitleg: Crosses from both sides, in turn. Two strikers attack the box with an agreed run: one to the near post, the other to the far post. First a cross from the right to the near post, then a cross from the left to the far post. The striker heads the ball down into the corner.
veld-af-kopballen-voorzet.organisatie: On half a pitch. Wide players with balls on the left and right, 18 m from the byline and 24 m from the centre. Two strikers centrally at 22–24 m. Keeper in goal. After a few crosses, the strikers swap runs.
coachpunten: Curve your run: first away from the post, then attack it
Take off from one foot, head it with your forehead, eyes open
Head it down: a bouncing ball is the hardest for a keeper

makkelijker: Throw the cross in by hand
moeilijker: The wide players cross on the run
A third runner to the edge of the box for the second ball

veld-af-wedstrijdje-schieten.uitleg: Two teams queue side by side at 18 m and take turns to shoot at goal. A goal is a point; low into the corner (below knee height and close to the post) is two points. After your shot, fetch your ball and join the back of your queue. Which team has the most points after five rounds?
veld-af-wedstrijdje-schieten.organisatie: Two queues with balls 18 m from goal, 6 m apart. Keeper in goal. The coach keeps the score.
coachpunten: Placement beats power: low into the corner is hardest for the keeper
Standing foot next to the ball, knee over the ball
Pick your corner before your run-up and stick to it

moeilijker: First a one-two with the coach, then shoot first time

veld-mt-pionnen-omgooien.uitleg: Look at those tall cones. Stand behind the line and knock them over! Boom, there goes one. The coach quickly stands them up again. How many can you knock over?
veld-mt-pionnen-omgooien.organisatie: 5 tall cones in a row, shooting line 5 m away. All the children shoot at the same time, each with a ball, and fetch their own ball. The coach stands the cones back up. For 5 children; nobody waits. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look at the ball when you shoot

veld-mt-dribbel-en-schiet.uitleg: Dribble through the gate, look at the mini-goal and shoot! Did it go in? Fetch your ball and join the back of the line.
veld-mt-dribbel-en-schiet.organisatie: Gate of 2 disc cones (2 m wide) 5 m from the start, mini-goal 5 m further on. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Keep the ball close to your foot
Look up before you shoot

veld-mt-ballen-van-de-pion.uitleg: There are balls on cones in the goal. Aim carefully and shoot them off! Did the ball fall off the cone? Then you hit it.
veld-mt-ballen-van-de-pion.organisatie: E-goal with 3 large cones on the goal line, a ball on each cone. Shooting line 6 m away. The coach puts the balls back. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Aim at the cone
Not too hard: aim well

veld-mt-hoekenjacht.uitleg: There’s a net in the goal with holes in the corners. Do you shoot through a hole? You get 3 points! Do you hit the net? You get 1 point. Who has the most points?
veld-mt-hoekenjacht.organisatie: E-goal with a net with open corners. Shooting line 6 m away. Through a corner = 3 points, anywhere else in the goal = 1 point. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look at the corner and aim

makkelijker: Place the ball and shoot calmly

veld-mt-slalom-en-scoren.uitleg: Dribble past the cones like a snake. At the last cone, look up and shoot at the mini-goal. Goal!
veld-mt-slalom-en-scoren.organisatie: 3 cones 2 m apart, mini-goal 4 m after the last cone. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Small touches around the cones

veld-mt-kleurendoel.uitleg: There’s a coloured disc cone by each mini-goal. Dribble! When the coach calls "red", shoot at the mini-goal with the red disc cone. Listen carefully!
veld-mt-kleurendoel.organisatie: Two mini-goals 5 m apart, each with a disc cone in its own colour. The children dribble 7 m in front of them; the coach calls a colour. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up and listen
Set the ball and then shoot

veld-mt-poortjesschieten.uitleg: There are three gates. The wide gate is easy: 1 point. The narrow gate is hard: 3 points! Which gate will you choose?
veld-mt-poortjesschieten.organisatie: 3 gates of disc cones in a line (2 m, 1.5 m and 1 m wide), shooting line 5 m away. Wide = 1 point, narrow = 3 points. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Softly, and aim well

veld-mt-aannemen-en-schieten.uitleg: The coach plays the ball to you. Stop the ball with your foot. Look at the mini-goal and shoot! Time to score.
veld-mt-aannemen-en-schieten.organisatie: Coach 5 m to the side with the balls, child 6 m from the mini-goal. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Stop it first, then shoot

makkelijker: The coach rolls the ball by hand
moeilijker: The ball comes from the other side

veld-mt-kaatsen-en-schieten.uitleg: Play the ball against the rebound board. It comes back! Control it and shoot at the mini-goal.
veld-mt-kaatsen-en-schieten.organisatie: Rebound board at an angle 4 m away, mini-goal 7 m away. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Stop the ball before you shoot

makkelijker: The coach rolls the ball in

veld-mt-hoepelpass.uitleg: Play the ball gently so that it stays in the hoop. Walk over to it. Now you get one shot at the mini-goal. A hit?
veld-mt-hoepelpass.organisatie: Hoop 4 m from the start, mini-goal 5 m further on. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Play it softly

makkelijker: A bigger hoop or two hoops

veld-mt-hordes-en-schieten.uitleg: Jump over the three hurdles like a frog. Then the coach gives you a ball. Shoot it into the mini-goal!
veld-mt-hordes-en-schieten.organisatie: 3 low hurdles 1.5 m apart, coach to the side with the balls, mini-goal 5 m after the last hurdle. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Jump on two feet
Look at the ball

makkelijker: The coach sets the ball ready

veld-mt-om-de-pop.uitleg: Dribble around the mannequin. Look up: there’s the goal. Shoot!
veld-mt-om-de-pop.organisatie: Mannequin 5 m from the start, mini-goal 5 m behind it. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Calmly around the mannequin, then shoot

makkelijker: Stop the ball before the shot
moeilijker: Go left and right around it

veld-mt-ladder-en-scoren.uitleg: Go through the speed ladder with quick feet. Your ball is by the cone. Take it and shoot at the mini-goal!
veld-mt-ladder-en-scoren.organisatie: Speed ladder, 1 m further on a cone with the balls, mini-goal 5 m away. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Small steps, then shoot calmly

veld-mt-tennisballen-van-de-pion.uitleg: There are tall cones in the goal with a tennis ball on top. That’s hard! Aim carefully and shoot the tennis ball off.
veld-mt-tennisballen-van-de-pion.organisatie: E-goal with 3 tall cones on the goal line, a tennis ball on each cone. Shooting line 5 m away. The coach puts the balls back. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look at the cone and shoot straight ahead

makkelijker: A football instead of a tennis ball

veld-mt-brug-en-goal.uitleg: Play the ball gently under the bridge. Step over the bridge yourself. Take your ball and shoot into the mini-goal!
veld-mt-brug-en-goal.organisatie: High hurdle 4 m from the start, mini-goal 5 m after the hurdle. For 5 children: set the drill up twice side by side, so there are at most 2–3 in a line. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Softly under the bridge, hard at the goal

makkelijker: Roll the ball under the bridge by hand
